clips.title: The story
paras: Vorsha the Lasher is a violent hydra terrorizing the Horde's foothold at Zoram'gar Outpost along the coast of Ashenvale. Revering the creature's ferocity, the local naga maintain an offering brazier on an offshore island to honor her. By extinguishing this sacred flame, Horde champions provoke Vorsha and draw her ashore to end her predatory assaults.

Zoram'gar Outpost sits on a tenuous strip of coast in northwestern Ashenvale, constantly besieged by hostile wildlife, night elves, and serpentine invaders. Among the most destructive threats prowling the Zoram Strand is Vorsha the Lasher, a gargantuan hydra known for brutal, unprovoked strikes against the outpost. The beast emerges from the surf to crush fortifications and butcher warriors before vanishing back into the deep tides.

The nearby naga do not merely tolerate the ravenous hydra; they actively venerate her predatory malice. On a rocky outcrop off the strand, the serpentine fiends keep an offering brazier burning continuously in tribute to Vorsha. Muglash, an orc determined to end the constant harassment of the outpost, realized that defiling this ritual flame would bring the beast surging to the surface in a fury, allowing the defenders to lure her into an ambush rather than waiting for another surprise slaughter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vorsha the Lasher... The fiendish hydra that roams the seas...
She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.
But I am ready, friend. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.
The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.
We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.
We are in your debt, friend.
